title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a ruler-reading practice sheet with real photos
body:
## Problem
Session 1 says a ruler reads 12.3 +- 0.1 cm but gives no practice reading real rulers.

## Context
Students learn the idea of an error interval fastest by doing it themselves.

## Expected outcome
A one-page sheet (in `docs/`) with five ruler photos or drawings, where students write value +- error and the relative error.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `docs/`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Five items with an answer key
- [ ] Images under 200 KB each

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: Latin hypercube sampling
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's sampling milestones do not exist yet; plain Monte Carlo needs many draws.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. A plain Monte Carlo run with 200 draws misses the spread of the pendulum g by about 4 percent.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a three-input correlated sampler
body:
## Problem
Session 2 links only two inputs with a correlation rho.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 1 asks for any number of inputs with a correlation matrix.

## Expected outcome
A function and a short lesson using a Cholesky factor, plus a checkpoint.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sample correlation matrix within 0.01 of the target
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated propagation
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows an input cloud, an output histogram with the linear Gaussian and an error budget; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At most 60 frames and under 3 MB
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
